dialogues.speaker: Bahram
dialogues.text: It's enough to make the ends meet.

dialogues.speaker: Bahram
dialogues.text: This is a key area on the river path to Sumeru, so many caravans pass through all year round.

dialogues.speaker: Bahram
dialogues.text: But you can travel along the river to Port Ormos, so few merchants would stay here.

dialogues.speaker: Bahram
dialogues.text: But it's also a good thing. Fewer merchants, less competition, you know.
